maps.title: RBI–NBFC Regulation Map
maps.categoryCaveat: Layer and category tags were checked on 24-11-2026 against each instrument's applicability paragraph, which the tag's tooltip cites. Only the lowest layer an instrument reaches is tagged: under Scale Based Regulation the layers are cumulative, so choosing a layer also shows instruments tagged to the layers below it. Some instruments apply within a layer only above a size test (for example ₹5,000 crore of assets); the tooltip says so. Check the clause before relying on a tag.

milestones.label: Consolidation: 244 Master Directions issued, 9,445 circulars withdrawn

maps.caveatShort: Tags checked against each applicability paragraph (24-11-2026); layers include lower layers. See the clause.
